title: Demo farm: a farm change on a host without the farm image builds it before the config test instead of failing to pull
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/demo-farm-callers.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the result of the config-test and image-ensure cases named in run.tests.
expect: farm_config_test on a host without the farm image runs web/build.sh demos before the throwaway config-test container, and the container is run without --pull.
farm_config_test on a host that has the image builds nothing.
evidence: 15/11/2026 dev: after the deploy that moved DEMOS_IMAGE to -r4, farm-switch.sh stopped with 'pull access denied for tracy/web-demos' / 'the config test fails'; with the fix, farm_config_test inside tracy-host (Docker Compose v2.29.7, no run --pull) passes php-fpm -t and apache2ctl -t, rc 0.
fence: Unit cases with a fake docker; a real build of a missing image on a host is not part of this case's run.

tests: farm_config_test: a missing farm image is built before the throwaway container runs; a present one is not
farm_image_ensure: a host without the farm image builds it (web/build.sh demos) before the first fold uses it
